import dataclasses
import unittest

from solution import Route, compile_routes


def handler_a():
    return "a"


def handler_b():
    return "b"


class RouteTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_routes_preserve_order_and_callable_identity(self):
        specs = [("/b", handler_b, "bee"), ("/a", handler_a, "aye")]
        routes = compile_routes(specs)
        self.assertEqual([(r.path, r.name) for r in routes], [("/b", "bee"), ("/a", "aye")])
        self.assertIs(routes[0].handler, handler_b)
        self.assertIs(routes[1].handler, handler_a)
        with self.assertRaises(dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError):
            routes[0].path = "/changed"

    def test_assets_are_sorted_and_appended(self):
        assets = {"/z.css": handler_b, "/a.js": handler_a}
        routes = compile_routes([("/home", handler_a, "home")], assets)
        self.assertEqual(
            [(r.path, r.name) for r in routes],
            [("/home", "home"), ("/a.js", "asset:/a.js"), ("/z.css", "asset:/z.css")],
        )
        self.assertIs(routes[1].handler, handler_a)
        self.assertIs(routes[2].handler, handler_b)

    def test_empty_inputs_and_fresh_lists(self):
        first = compile_routes([])
        second = compile_routes([], {})
        self.assertEqual(first, [])
        self.assertEqual(second, [])
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        nonempty_first = compile_routes([("/", handler_a, "root")])
        nonempty_second = compile_routes([("/", handler_a, "root")])
        self.assertIsNot(nonempty_first, nonempty_second)

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        specs = [["/one", handler_a, "one"]]
        assets = {"/asset": handler_b}
        specs_before = [item[:] for item in specs]
        assets_before = assets.copy()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compile_routes(specs, assets)
        self.assertEqual(specs, specs_before)
        self.assertEqual(assets, assets_before)

    def test_each_spec_must_be_three_item_tuple(self):
        malformed = [
            [("/x", handler_a)],
            [("/x", handler_a, "x", "extra")],
            [["/x", handler_a, "x"]],
            ["abc"],
        ]
        for specs in malformed:
            with self.subTest(specs=specs):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    compile_routes(specs)

    def test_invalid_route_values(self):
        bad_specs = [
            [("", handler_a, "name")],
            [(1, handler_a, "name")],
            [("/x", object(), "name")],
            [("/x", handler_a, "")],
            [("/x", handler_a, 1)],
        ]
        for specs in bad_specs:
            with self.subTest(specs=specs):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    compile_routes(specs)

    def test_duplicate_paths_and_names(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compile_routes([("/x", handler_a, "x"), ("/x", handler_b, "y")])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compile_routes([("/x", handler_a, "same"), ("/y", handler_b, "same")])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compile_routes([("/x", handler_a, "x")], {"/x": handler_b})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compile_routes([("/ordinary", handler_a, "asset:/file")], {"/file": handler_b})

    def test_invalid_assets(self):
        for assets in [[], {"": handler_a}, {1: handler_a}, {"/x": object()}]:
            with self.subTest(assets=assets):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    compile_routes([], assets)

    def test_generator_specs_are_supported(self):
        specs = ((path, handler_a, name) for path, name in [("/1", "one"), ("/2", "two")])
        self.assertEqual([r.name for r in compile_routes(specs)], ["one", "two"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
